lines.cap: London, 1971. A gang rented a shop two doors down from a Lloyds Bank, on Baker Street.
lines.say: London, 1971. A gang rented a shop two doors down from a Lloyds Bank, on Baker Street.

lines.cap: They dug a tunnel about forty feet long, under a restaurant, right up into the bank's vault.
lines.say: They dug a tunnel about forty feet long, under a restaurant, right up into the bank's vault.

lines.cap: A lookout on the roof talked to them on walkie-talkies. But a local radio fan, Robert Rowlands, picked up their chatter at home.
lines.say: A lookout on the roof talked to them on walkie-talkies. But a local radio fan, Robert Rowlands, picked up their chatter at home.

lines.cap: He called the police and recorded everything. But they didn't say which bank. Police checked hundreds of banks.
lines.say: He called the police and recorded everything. But they didn't say which bank. Police checked hundreds of banks.

lines.cap: By Monday, the gang had emptied hundreds of safety deposit boxes.
lines.say: By Monday, the gang had emptied hundreds of safety deposit boxes.

lines.cap: Four men were eventually jailed. But most of the loot was never found.
lines.say: Four men were eventually jailed. But most of the loot was never found.

lines.cap: Never talk shop on an open channel.
